notes: tau is an EVTSP Case B decision variable with search range [0.70, 0.90].
Q_ratio replaces legacy Q_trig and is converted to Q_th = Q_ratio * L at runtime.
seed and demand scale remain experiment design or robustness factors, not theta variables.

stage1_audit.time_axis_policy: SUMO relative 0-1800 retained; 61200-64800 stored as absolute metadata only

stage_policy.stage1: dispatch capture and static route/movement/storage precompute
stage_policy.stage2: departure/merge zone space control before EV joins mainline
stage_policy.stage3: preemptive control of controllable movements ahead of the EV
stage_policy.bottleneck_order: open mapped downstream bottleneck movement first, upstream movement later

case_b_candidates.measurement_source: SUMO B04 no-control B0 measured proxy
case_b_candidates.mapping_policy: Exact mapped controllable SUMO movements are preferred; otherwise S7/S10/S11 use conservative route-span proxy mapping to existing controllable movements.

duplicate_movement_pairs.runtime_policy: choose active duplicate with largest live segment fill; fall back to B0 segment fill

case_b_candidates.runtime_duplicate_policy: When multiple Case B segments map to the same bottleneck/upstream movement pair, the runtime evaluates all active duplicates and selects the one with the largest live segment fill, falling back to B0 segment fill.

source_policy.policy: SUMO B04 no-control B0 measured proxy fills q_avg/q_max/tQ_hist/lambda.
Runtime n_occ wins; B0 mean/max is fallback only when merge lanes are unavailable.
Runtime queue wins; stale or empty runtime queue may use B0 tQ_hist.
Runtime tau wins; mapped B0 prior can mark Case B when runtime queue is not decisive.
